edges.reason: msg.sender is passed into _transfer through transfer/transferFrom and drives bot, limit and ownership checks.
msg.sender is used as the owner argument of _approve in approve.
msg.sender is used for the allowance lookup and spender update in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the sender of the ERC20 transfer entry point.
manualSwap requires _msgSender() to equal the fee wallet address.
manualSend requires _msgSender() to equal the fee wallet address.
msg.sender reaches _approve as the spender argument.
block.timestamp gates the per-address cooldown and therefore transfer success.
block.timestamp is supplied as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is supplied as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
cooldown mapping values are compared against and written from block.timestamp.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when the swap threshold is met, initiating an external token swap.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which performs an external ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
sendETHToFee forwards the ETH amount to the unsafe external transfer call.
swapTokensForEth passes tokenAmount and the path to the router swap external call.
The external ETH transfer targets the _feeAddrWallet1 fee recipient.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance and token balance.
openTrading calls the factory createPair to create the Uniswap pair.
openTrading calls approve on the created pair with max allowance.
openTrading assigns the hardcoded router instance to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for WETH and the swap call.
swapTokensForEth calls _approve to allow the router to spend tokens.
openTrading calls _approve for the router allowance.
transfer invokes _transfer.
transferFrom invokes _transfer.
transferFrom invokes _approve to decrement the allowance.
approve invokes _approve.
_transfer delegates the balance mutation to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to allocate team tokens.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to apply reflection fees.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute amount splits.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token-side values.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection-side values.
_getValues calls _getRate for the current rate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for supply values.
tokenFromReflection calls _getRate.
balanceOf calls tokenFromReflection.
_transfer calls balanceOf for balance and limit checks.
manualSwap triggers swapTokensForEth and thus an external swap.
manualSend triggers sendETHToFee and thus an external ETH transfer.
manualSwap reads the contract token balance via balanceOf.
_transfer drives balance mutations on the reflection balance mapping.
_transferStandard reads and writes _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_takeTeam credits the contract reflection balance in _rOwned.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal via SafeMath.sub.
_reflectFee adds the token fee to _tFeeTotal via SafeMath.add.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
_transfer reads fee-exclusion flags to branch behaviour.
_transferStandard checks isExcludedFromFee for sender and recipient.
_transfer reads limit-exclusion flags for max amount and max wallet checks.
_transfer enforces the bot blacklist before transferring.
setBots writes true into the bots mapping for each address.
delBot clears the bot flag for an address.
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping using block.timestamp.
_transfer compares the contract token balance against swapThreshold.
_transfer checks inSwap before performing an automatic swap.
The lockTheSwap modifier sets and clears inSwap around the swap body.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before swapping tokens for ETH.
_transfer gates the cooldown logic on cooldownEnabled.
_transfer enforces _maxTxAmount on transfers.
_transfer enforces _maxWalletAmount on recipient balances.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading exempts the router and pair from limits.
openTrading sends the initial liquidity to the owner address derived from the fee/owner state.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the _feeAddrWallet1 payable wallet.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
changeMaxTxAmount writes _maxTxAmount.
changeMaxWalletAmount writes _maxWalletAmount.
changeSwapThreshold writes swapThreshold.
excludeFromFees writes the isExcludedFromFee mapping.
excludeFromLimits writes the isExcludedFromLimit mapping.
The from parameter flows into _transfer checks and balance updates.
The to parameter flows into _transfer limit and cooldown checks.
The amount parameter flows into _transfer limit checks and the token transfer.
tokenAmount is passed to the router swap call in swapTokensForEth.
bots_ array elements are written into the bots mapping in setBots.
amount is assigned to _maxTxAmount in changeMaxTxAmount.
amount is forwarded to the external ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
tAmount flows into the value computations of _transferStandard.
tTeam is multiplied by the current rate in _takeTeam.
account is the key written in excludeFromFees.
excluded is the boolean value written in excludeFromFees.
contractTokenBalance is compared to swapThreshold inside _transfer.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee in _transfer.
path array is passed to the router swap call.
currentRate divides the reflection amount in tokenFromReflection.
rAmount is subtracted from the sender reflection balance in _transferStandard.
rTransferAmount is added to the recipient reflection balance in _transferStandard.
currentRate multiplies tTeam in _takeTeam.
contractBalance is passed to swapTokensForEth in manualSwap.
The reflection fee is multiplied by the amount in _getTValues.
The team fee is multiplied by the amount in _getTValues.
The external ETH transfer to the fee wallet can re-enter the transfer path before state finalization.
The external router swap can invoke token callbacks that re-enter the transfer path.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter only consumed by _transfer address checks.
to is a parameter only consumed by _transfer limit and cooldown checks.
amount is a parameter only consumed by _transfer limit checks and transfer call.
tokenAmount only parameterizes the router swap in swapTokensForEth.
bots_ is only iterated to populate the bots mapping in setBots.
amount is only assigned to _maxTxAmount in changeMaxTxAmount.
amount is only forwarded to the unsafe ETH transfer inside sendETHToFee.
tAmount only feeds the value computation of _transferStandard.
tTeam is only converted to reflection tokens inside _takeTeam.
account is only used as the mapping key in excludeFromFees.
excluded is only used as the boolean value in excludeFromFees.
contractTokenBalance is the amount auto-swapped via swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is the amount forwarded to sendETHToFee.
path is a swap route array only used for the router call in swapTokensForEth.
currentRate is only the divisor used in tokenFromReflection.
rAmount is only used for sender balance subtraction in _transferStandard.
rTransferAmount is only used for recipient balance addition in _transferStandard.
currentRate is only the multiplier used in _takeTeam.
contractBalance is only passed as the swap amount from manualSwap.
